from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import FormulaRule
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/CF_12196/1_CF_12196_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/CF_12196_0_b79c503d/1_CF_12196_output.xlsx')
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Apply conditional formatting only to the requested answer range.
# The rule highlights an order cell when it is greater than 75% of the weekly
# delivery quantity in column A on the same row.
answer_range = "C3:G6"
green_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="00B050")

# Remove any pre-existing conditional formatting rules that overlap exactly this
# answer range only, to avoid duplicate/conflicting rules if present.
# (Do not alter rules elsewhere.)
try:
    cf_obj = ws.conditional_formatting
    for cf_range in list(cf_obj._cf_rules.keys()):
        if str(cf_range.sqref) == answer_range:
            del cf_obj._cf_rules[cf_range]
except Exception:
    pass

rule = FormulaRule(formula=["C3>0.75*$A3"], fill=green_fill)
ws.conditional_formatting.add(answer_range, rule)

wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")

ws = wb['Sheet1']

print("Values in Sheet1!C3:G6:")
for r in range(3, 7):
    row_vals = []
    for c in range(3, 8):
        row_vals.append(ws.cell(r, c).value)
    print(r, row_vals)

print("\nConditional formatting rules:")
for cf in ws.conditional_formatting:
    print("range:", cf.sqref)
    for rule in cf.rules:
        print("  type:", rule.type, "formula:", rule.formula)
        if rule.dxf and rule.dxf.fill:
            fill = rule.dxf.fill
            print("  fill:", fill.fill_type, fill.fgColor.type, fill.fgColor.rgb, fill.fgColor.indexed)

# Compute which cells in the answer range should be highlighted by the CF rule,
# based on current input values.
print("\nCells in C3:G6 where order > 75% of column A delivery:")
for r in range(3, 7):
    weekly_delivery = ws.cell(r, 1).value
    marked = []
    for c in range(3, 8):
        val = ws.cell(r, c).value
        if isinstance(weekly_delivery, (int, float)) and isinstance(val, (int, float)) and val > 0.75 * weekly_delivery:
            marked.append(ws.cell(r, c).coordinate)
    print(r, "weekly_delivery=", weekly_delivery, "highlight_if_true=", marked)
